title: Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro – 20W Laser Engraver Review
excerpt: A detailed review of the Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro, featuring performance tests, engraving results and safety features.
body:
## Overview The Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro is a powerful and versatile diode laser engraver designed for makers, hobbyists and small workshop users. Featuring a 20W laser module, upgraded 32-bit motherboard and multiple safety systems, it stands out as one of the most capable machines in its class. In this project, I tested the machine by engraving and cutting different materials, as well as running real workflow tests using LightBurn. *Note: This machine was provided by Ortur for review purposes.* ## First Impressions Ortur has become a well-known and respected brand in the laser engraving space. Their focus has always been clear: - Improving safety - Increasing performance - Making laser engraving more accessible The Laser Master 2 Pro follows that philosophy very closely. ## Performance & Capability This machine delivers impressive performance thanks to its high-speed engraving and precise laser control. Key highlights include: - Engraving speed up to 10,000 mm/min - High precision thanks to extended laser control range (S0 – S1000) - Smooth operation due to a 32-bit controller In real use, this means faster jobs, cleaner engraving and better detail compared to older 8-bit systems. ## Build Quality The all-metal construction gives the machine a solid and stable feel. Assembly is quick and straightforward, taking around 10–20 minutes, making it accessible even for beginners. The large working area (400 x 400 mm) also allows for bigger projects and more flexibility. ## Safety Features Safety is one of the strongest aspects of this machine. It includes several important systems: - Motion detection (G-sensor stops laser if moved) - Laser shutdown on connection loss - Overexposure protection These features significantly reduce risks such as accidental exposure or fire hazards. ## Software Compatibility The Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro works with both free and paid software. ### LaserGRBL (Free) - Easy to use - Ideal for beginners - Works well for simple engraving projects ### LightBurn (Recommended) - Advanced control and workflow - Layer management and precision settings - Best option for serious use ## Materials Tested During testing, the machine handled multiple materials: - Wood - Cardboard - Leather - Acrylic (engraving) Results were clean, detailed and consistent across most materials. ## Important Safety Notes When using any laser engraver, safety is critical: - Always wear proper safety goggles - Never touch the laser emitter - Keep children away from the machine - Avoid reflective surfaces Laser machines are not toys and must be used carefully. ## Specifications - Model: Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro - Laser Power: 20W (5–5.5W optical) - Laser Wavelength: 445 ±5nm - Working Area: 400 x 400 mm - Power Supply: 24V 2A - Material: Aluminum + Powder Coated Steel ## Verdict The Ortur Laser Master 2 Pro is a solid choice for anyone looking to step into laser engraving or upgrade from an entry-level machine. With strong performance, advanced safety features and excellent compatibility with LightBurn, it offers a great balance between price and capability. It is especially suitable for hobbyists and small workshop environments. ## Image Gallery
